# CleanTune - Warzone / BO7 - V1 No Gun
# Pre-HeSuVi chain, 7.1. Built to push your own gunfire right down.
#
# How it works: your own gun is the loudest thing in the mix and sits in the
# front and centre channels. Enemies behind and beside you come through the
# rear and side channels. So this:
#   1. Squashes loud hits on the front channels with a multiband compressor.
#      Quiet sounds like footsteps stay under the threshold and pass through.
#   2. Drops the centre channel hard, where most of your own weapon lives.
#   3. Halves the sub channel to kill the gun and explosion thump.
#   4. Lifts footsteps on the rear and side channels.
#
# Needs ReaPlugs installed - the installer does this.
# Compressor layout idea learned from ArtTuneDB by ArtIsWar, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
# Band values are CleanTune's own:
#   <110 Hz    -24 dB  6:1     thump
#   110-500    -30 dB  8:1     body
#   500-1.5k   -36 dB  10:1    bark
#   1.5k-2.5k  -36 dB  10:1    crack
#   2.5k+      -30 dB  8:1     snap and tail
# Channels: L R C LFE RL RR SL SR

Preamp: -7 dB

# ---- Front channels: squash your own gun ----
Channel: L R
VSTPlugin: Library "C:\Program Files\VSTPlugins\ReaPlugs\reaxcomp-standalone.dll" ChunkData ""
Preamp: -4 dB

# ---- Centre channel: where your own weapon sits ----
Channel: C
Preamp: -12 dB

# ---- Sub channel: kill the thump ----
Channel: LFE
Preamp: -9 dB

# ---- All channels: same footstep EQ as Competitive ----
Channel: all
Filter: ON HP Fc 28 Hz Q 0.707
Filter: ON LSC Fc 120 Hz Gain -4 dB Q 0.7
Filter: ON PK Fc 300 Hz Gain -2.5 dB Q 1.0
Filter: ON PK Fc 1100 Hz Gain 1.5 dB Q 1.2
Filter: ON PK Fc 3200 Hz Gain 4 dB Q 1.1
Filter: ON PK Fc 6500 Hz Gain -3 dB Q 2.0
Filter: ON HSC Fc 10000 Hz Gain -1 dB Q 0.7

# ---- Rear and side channels: enemies around you ----
Channel: RL RR SL SR
Preamp: 1 dB
Filter: ON PK Fc 2800 Hz Gain 2 dB Q 1.0

Channel: all
